tasks.label: Debug parser snippet
tasks.command:
node -e "const rawText='
{
  "model_name": "DemoModel",
  "version": "1.0",
  "dataset": "DemoData",
  "overview": "A compact overview",
  "architecture": "Transformer-based workflow",
  "limitations": ["English only", 42],
  "metrics": {"accuracy": 1, "f1_score": 0.91},
  "warnings": ["Needs human review"]
'; let cleaned=rawText.trim(); let parsed; const tryParseJson=(candidate)=>{const attempts=[candidate]; if(candidate.startsWith('{')){attempts.push(`${candidate}}`); const normalized=candidate.replace(/,\s*([}\]])/g,'$1'); if(normalized!==candidate){attempts.push(normalized); attempts.push(`${normalized}}`);} } for(const attempt of attempts){try{return JSON.parse(attempt)}catch{}} return null}; try{parsed=JSON.parse(cleaned)}catch{const start=cleaned.indexOf('{'); const end=cleaned.lastIndexOf('}'); const candidate=start!==-1 && end>start ? cleaned.slice(start,end+1): cleaned.trim(); parsed=tryParseJson(candidate);} console.log(JSON.stringify(parsed));"
